## What happened?

Describe the unexpected result.

## How can we reproduce it?

List the command, operating system, Python version, and ActivityWatch version.

## Expected result

Describe what you expected instead.

## Privacy check

Please remove window titles, URLs, account names, local paths, and raw ActivityWatch data before submitting. A minimal synthetic example is enough.
